title: Vietnam Airlines
description: vietnamairlines.com Revenue $4.4 Billion Vietnam Airlines is the national flag carrier of Vietnam, founded in 1956 and listed as HVN, with hubs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and about 86 percent state ownership together with ANA Holdings as strategic investor. It is a SkyTeam member operating 103 aircraft including Airbus A350s and Boeing 787 Dreamliners across 113 routes to 39 international destinations in 22 countries. In 2025 it posted record results with consolidated and net profit of 290 million dollars, carrying 25.6 million passengers. In February 2026 it finalized an order for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets worth about 10 billion dollars. The group includes Pacific Airlines, VASCO, VAECO maintenance and SKYPEC fuel units. Its target is to become a five-star Skytrax airline and the number two carrier in Southeast Asia by 2030.
